evals.prompt: Fais-moi un short avec cette vidéo : engine/test/speech.mp4
evals.expected_output: The skill checks the machine, reads the rush, then asks the starting questions in two AskUserQuestion calls with the user's defaults, before creating the project.
expectations: Runs `video.mjs doctor` before any other command of the skill
Runs `video.mjs probe` on the rush and `video.mjs codecs` before asking the starting questions
Asks the starting questions in two AskUserQuestion calls: Formats, Résolution and Règles first, then Cadence and Codec
The Règles question puts « Aucune règle (recommandé) » first, before any pack
The Formats question marks 16:9 « (format d'origine) » (the rush is 1920×1080)
The Cadence question puts « Cadence d'origine (30 i/s) » first
Talks to the user in French

evals.prompt: Crée une vidéo motion design de 20 secondes qui présente le rendu vidéo local : 9:16, 1080p, aucune règle, 30 i/s, H.264.
evals.expected_output: A video made from scratch, no footage asked for, the questions answered by the request skipped, the Direction written before the scene.
expectations: Never asks the user for footage
Asks no starting question the request already answers (formats, resolution, rules, rate, codec)
Runs `video.mjs init` without `--source`, with `--formats 9:16 --renders 1080p --fps 30 --codec h264 --rules none`
Sets `duration` in source/edit.json
Writes the Direction section of About.md before writing source/scene.js
Runs `video.mjs stills` and `video.mjs check` before rendering

evals.prompt: Fais un clip vertical du passage entre 0:10 et 0:35 de engine/test/speech.mp4, en 9:16 720p, pack podcast-clip, cadence d'origine, H.264.
evals.expected_output: Only the requested range of the rush becomes the source.
expectations: Runs `video.mjs init` with `--source` ending in `#t=0:10,0:35` (or the same range in seconds)
Runs `video.mjs init` with `--rules podcast-clip`
Runs `video.mjs prepare` then `video.mjs rough`
The project's source/project.json gives a source of about 25 s

evals.prompt: Pour mes shorts, je ne veux plus jamais de tape stop, retiens-le.
evals.expected_output: The preference is saved as a personal line of the shorts pack, extending the plugin's one.
expectations: Writes `.rules/shorts.md` in the projects folder with `extends: shorts` in its frontmatter
The file holds the user's line about the tape stop, not a copy of the plugin's pack
Does not edit any file inside the plugin's rules/ folder
Runs `video.mjs rules list` and the shorts pack appears with no broken line

evals.expected_output: The style interview, the vocabulary of the transcript included, written with one style set.
expectations: Interviews the user with AskUserQuestion where the answers are choices
Asks for the names the transcript must spell right (creator.vocabulary)
Writes the answers with `video.mjs style set`, not by editing style.json
Shows the resulting STYLE.md
